record.label: Host compute-value attribution
record.summary: The compute-value attribution is solved. It correctly identified the unconditional PSD-repair eigendecomposition as low-value compute; the conditional Cholesky implementation failed on board as #328400, while the simpler unconditional removal graded successfully in #328439 at raw 2.9409159800763974e-8 and adjusted 2.2842888692472472e-8. CP3 remains load-bearing and the current trim/no-eigh route is terminally banked.
record.terminal_criterion: Solved: the attribution receipt exists with exact hashes and one measured reallocation candidate. The sole licensed successor is the conditional-repair deployment card P2R0F2W; any lambda-cubed reallocation arm requires its own node after W validates the freed-budget mechanism at scale.
